rubric_items.reason: API list mapping, the web column, truncation and the default prop are all tested. S-2 AC3 (300-char reason on the detail page) and the dashboard/doctor API shapes are not.
Most assertions check exact cell text, header order and the link href. The S-5 AC4 test only compares headers, and its fixture has no contact or history fields that could leak.
Covers exactly 60, 61, 300, astral characters, Cancelled with a null reason, and other statuses. No 300-char reason on the detail page and no web error path for the list.
Vitest + jsdom + Testing Library for web and Vitest + Supertest in the existing API file, as the strategy says. Test names start with HMS-33 REQ-n, not a PRD-style ID.
Coverage is honestly reported as skipped, and no numbers are invented. The claim that checks.json records test counts is not true: the test step has no report.

findings.text: Known says S-2 AC3 (a 300-char reason shown whole on the appointment's page) is covered by APT-6/APT-11/APT-1. Those tests only cancel with the short 'Patient requested', so no test checks that a long reason stays unshortened on the detail page.

cites.quote: S-2 AC3 (full reason on the appointment's page)
send({ reason: 'Patient requested' })

findings.suggested_fix: Add an API test that cancels with a 300-character reason and asserts that GET /api/appointments/:id returns it whole, or stop claiming that existing tests cover S-2 AC3.

findings.text: Summary says tsl records the test counts in checks.json, but the verifier's test step has no report. Nothing shows the DB-gated API tests ran instead of being skipped, so 'passed every test' cannot be checked for them.

cites.quote: tsl records the test counts in checks.json when it runs the verifier (H3)
"report_sha256": null,
describe.skipIf(!pgAvailable())

findings.suggested_fix: State that the verifier gives no per-test counts and that the API tests are skipped unless a test database is available.

findings.text: Test naming: the strategy wants names that start with the requirement ID (DOC-1, APT-4). The new tests start with 'HMS-33 REQ-n', a ticket-local ID, instead of an ID in the PRD style.

cites.quote: Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID (DOC-1, APT-4, ...).
HMS-33 REQ-3, REQ-4: list items carry the cancellation reason

findings.text: S-5 AC1/AC2 are tested only by rendering AppointmentTable directly. At the API level only the patient response is checked, so the dashboard and doctor responses are never asserted to stay without the field.

cites.quote: <AppointmentTable items={[cancelled]} />
HMS-33 REQ-12: the patient page response does not gain the field

findings.suggested_fix: Add API assertions that the dashboard and doctor appointment responses have no cancellationReason.

findings.text: The S-5 AC4 test (no medical history or contact details) only compares header names. Its fixture patient has only id, code and fullName, and no API test checks that list items omit contact or history fields.
